alloy.preparation: Rolled sheet, vacuum-heated at 1050°C for 2 h, then water-quenched to 0°C. Electrochemical specimens 40 × 20 × 1.5 mm; emery-polished to No.6/0, cloth-polished with dilute chromium-oxide suspension, degreased with absolute ethanol, washed in distilled water and air-blast dried. PTFE tape over epoxy undercoat leaves 1 × 1 cm² exposed.

test_solution.preparation: Deaerated by bubbling purified nitrogen for more than 30 min.

test_method.procedure_description: Potential increased successively from the corrosion potential in 25-mV steps; current recorded after a 1-min hold at every setting. Stationary, deoxygenated solution at room temperature explicitly 25°C; saturated calomel reference.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Pitting susceptibility/passive breakdown identified from anodic polarization and the explicit accompanying text; transpassive dissolution is distinguished from pitting.

experiments.result_note: No pitting up to the onset of transpassive dissolution, ca. +0.85 V. Lower bound only; the transpassive event is not labeled as pitting.
